description: Familias afectadas por fenómenos de remoción en masa en Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Este indicador evidencia el comportamiento entre las variables de familias afectadas y Fenómenos de Remoción en Masa – FRM en Bogotá entre el 2007 y primer semestre de 2020. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Its tags are Salud Bogotá, Salud y Protección Social, Secretaria de Salud, salud, salud bogota. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-03-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
